paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
notes: CAST solar helioscope final vacuum phase (2013-2015). Main result g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 (95% C.L.) for m_a <= 0.02 eV. This is a stellar/solar axion search (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density assumed. The limit is mass-independent below ~0.02 eV; data points reflect the flat exclusion region.
